links.comparator_used: Models without MLOps-based updating and model selection during the simulation (median R2 of all models, no automated retraining)
links.outcome: Forecast accuracy (R2) for PED overcrowding during the simulation period
links.effect: Median R2 was 44% across all models, and improved to 60% after MLOps-based model selection
links.quote: Throughout the simulation, the median R<sup>2</sup> score for all models was 44% after MLOps-based model selection, the median R<sup>2</sup> improved to 60%.

links.comparator_used: Fixed, existing physician staffing schedule without forecast-based shift optimization
links.effect: Staffing adjusted in 69 of 84 shifts, physician allocation increased by up to 30.4% during peak hours, patient-to-physician ratio reduced by an average of 4.32 patients (8-16 shift) and 4.40 patients (16-24 shift)
links.quote: This adjustment reduced the patient-to-physician ratio by an average of 4.32 patients during the 8-16 shift and 4.40 patients during the 16-24 shift.

design_hint: MLOps automated retraining and model selection for drift
